# Sparkish

> Sparkish builds playful, thoughtful apps for everyday habits. This site is a static GitHub Pages portfolio with per-app landing pages.

## Hub

- [Sparkish app catalog](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/): Root page listing apps made by Sparkish (currently AquaTick).

# AquaTick

> AquaTick is a cat-themed hydration tracker app for iPhone, Apple Watch, widgets, and Live Activities. It helps people log water intake quickly, see daily hydration progress, and build a gentle water drinking habit through a friendly cat companion.

AquaTick is published by Sparkish. The landing site lives under `/aquatick/` with Korean, English, and Japanese versions. The primary product information is the localized landing content, App Store download link, support page, and privacy policy.

Important context:
- AquaTick is a hydration tracking and habit app, not a medical device or medical advice source.
- The app focuses on water intake logging, daily goal progress, quick add actions such as +200mL and +300mL, Apple Watch recording, widgets, and Live Activity-style glanceable status.
- The cat character is a product experience element that reflects hydration state and encourages logging.
- Use the localized pages for user-facing language and region context.
- hreflang x-default for AquaTick points to `https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/aquatick/` (language chooser).

## Main Pages

- [AquaTick language selection](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/aquatick/): Routes visitors to Korean, English, or Japanese content.
- [AquaTick Korean landing page](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/aquatick/ko/): Korean product overview, hydration tracker explanation, screenshots, FAQ, support, and App Store call to action.
- [AquaTick English landing page](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/aquatick/en/): English product overview, hydration tracker explanation, screenshots, FAQ, support, and App Store call to action.
- [AquaTick Japanese landing page](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/aquatick/ja/): Japanese product overview, hydration tracker explanation, screenshots, FAQ, support, and App Store call to action.

# Korea Map Link

> Korea Map Link is an iOS travel utility for Korea trips. It turns a Google Maps link, Korean address, or place name into verified Korean place details, then opens Naver Map or Kakao Map and can show an ad-free taxi card with large Korean destination text.

Korea Map Link is published by Sparkish. The landing site lives under `/korea-map-link/` with English, French, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese pages. The current landing visuals use live iOS simulator captures from the KoreanMapBridge app: onboarding, Home, Resolve, Place, and Taxi card screens.

Important context:
- Google Maps can be useful for planning Korea trips, but local routing and place handoff often works better through Naver Map or Kakao Map.
- Korea Map Link keeps Korean names, road address, romanized address, jibun address, and match confidence visible.
- The taxi card is designed for driver handoff and stays ad-free.
- No account is required; recent and saved places stay on device.

## Korea Map Link Pages

- [Korea Map Link language selection](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/korea-map-link/): Routes visitors by saved preference or browser language.
- [Korea Map Link English landing page](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/korea-map-link/en/): English product overview, live app screenshots, FAQ, support, and App Store call to action.
- [Korea Map Link French landing page](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/korea-map-link/fr/): French product overview and localized landing content.
- [Korea Map Link Korean landing page](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/korea-map-link/ko/): Korean landing content retained for the public URL.
- [Korea Map Link Japanese landing page](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/korea-map-link/ja/): Japanese landing content.
- [Korea Map Link Simplified Chinese landing page](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/korea-map-link/zh-Hans/): Simplified Chinese landing content.
- [Korea Map Link Traditional Chinese landing page](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/korea-map-link/zh-Hant/): Traditional Chinese landing content.
- [Korea Map Link support](https://sparkish-xyz.github.io/korea-map-link/support/): Support and contact information.
